style: 新国风水墨彩漫(黑白灰主调, 冷白高光, 古风妖魔, 电影感荒野雾气, 精致国漫脸)

panels.ink_plan: 冷月剪影线条清晰，人物轮廓和横刀用较重墨线。
panels.black_fill_plan: 土坡下方和远处虎妖尸影压黑，保留人物脸部冷白高光。
panels.tone_plan: 荒野背景 30% 灰阶，雾面留白，衣物和地面中灰。
panels.value_plan: three-value read: focal subject, acting silhouette, background depth must remain separable in grayscale
panels.effects_plan: 无速度线，只用风线和薄雾引导视线。
panels.no_bake_text_contract: dialogue and narration stay out of raw images; no blank bubbles/caption boxes/UI text/watermark/garbled text; drawn SFX only when listed in lettering_sfx_plan

panels.ink_plan: 土包、横刀和姜月初手部用清线，远景降低细节。
panels.black_fill_plan: 坑边阴影压黑，人物眼下加细黑影。
panels.tone_plan: 土坡中灰，雾面低网点，人物脸部留白。
panels.value_plan: three-value read: focal subject, acting silhouette, background depth must remain separable in grayscale
panels.effects_plan: 无动作效果，仅薄雾和风线。
panels.no_bake_text_contract: dialogue and narration stay out of raw images; no blank bubbles/caption boxes/UI text/watermark/garbled text; drawn SFX only when listed in lettering_sfx_plan

panels.ink_plan: 补给物边缘和手指接触点用细线，尸身轮廓简化。

panels.tone_plan: 衣料 40% 灰，地面 30% 灰，补给物高光。
panels.value_plan: three-value read: focal subject, acting silhouette, background depth must remain separable in grayscale
